Description

Notes

Some news report it being 2U while most other Spacety are 6U and photo proof also. ZERGLING is the English name of Tianyi ’s new satellite platform. This is the second on-orbit verification after the first test star launched in October 18, and the specific description is in the press release on August 31. ZERGLING is the most basic unit of the Zerg in the classic StarCraft game 20 years ago.
